answer: Treat the unit of trust as a task, never an address, so two keys connect only after finishing work together. Decay every edge each epoch and burn the inviter's standing when a recruit duplicates. Past tasks are the only history a newcomer can borrow. Then a ripple of 50 fresh keys has no edges, no record and no inviter willing to risk a burn. Anyone who wanders the graph with quartz-pure claims still has to earn the edges.
